anchors.paper_title: Contribution of Spectrotemporal Features on Auditory Event-Related Potentials Elicited by Consonant-Vowel Syllables
anchors.reason: 2009 ERP study of /da/ and /ta/ syllables in 10 adults; topically related to speech-evoked EEG but does not describe this TMS phoneme-discrimination dataset.

anchors.paper_title: Dynamic Encoding of Acoustic Features in Neural Responses to Continuous Speech
anchors.reason: Khalighinejad et al. 2017 studies EEG phoneme-related potentials during continuous speech; topically related but not the TMS phoneme discrimination EEG dataset by Moreira et al.

anchors.paper_title: Assessing cortical network properties using TMS–EEG
anchors.reason: A 2012 TMS-EEG review on cortical network properties. It is topically related to the TMS-EEG recordings but does not describe this speech-decoding dataset, and it is not a specific tool.

metadata.methods_description: Participants listened to speech sounds and identified stimuli with a button press while EEG was recorded. TMS was delivered with a Magstim Super Rapid Plus1 stimulator and a figure-of-eight 40 mm coil, using paired pulses with a 50 ms interpulse interval at 110% of resting motor threshold. Targets were lip and tongue areas of M1 in both studies, plus Broca's area (BA 44) and a verbal memory region (BA 6) in Study 2.
